title: Properties of the constructible separation data
statement:
The constructed subsets $T_c,T'_c$ are constructible and closed in $V$,
and they satisfy

$$
T\subseteq T_c,\qquad T'\subseteq T'_c,\qquad
T_c\cap T'_c=\varnothing.
$$

proof.text:
Complements of quasi-compact opens in a spectral space are constructible
closed subsets. The choice of $W$ gives $T\subseteq T_c$, the choice of
$W'$ gives $T'\subseteq T'_c$, and $V\setminus W\subseteq W'$ gives
$T_c\cap T'_c=\varnothing$.

blueprint_update.statement:
Suppose moreover that $V$ is quasi-separated (for instance a spectral
space). Then the constructed subsets $T_c,T'_c$ are constructible and
closed in $V$, and they satisfy

$$
T\subseteq T_c,\qquad T'\subseteq T'_c,\qquad
T_c\cap T'_c=\varnothing.
$$

proof.text:
In a quasi-separated space every quasi-compact open is retrocompact, so
its complement is a constructible closed subset. The choice of $W$ gives $T\subseteq T_c$, the choice of
$W'$ gives $T'\subseteq T'_c$, and $V\setminus W\subseteq W'$ gives
$T_c\cap T'_c=\varnothing$.
